items.text: Skyrim never ceases to amaze me

It's an incentive to stay fully fed, it creates a gameplay loop of needing to feed-putting yourself in a dangerous situation-Reward/Punishment. It pushes the game forward. 

The amount of times I've lived through wassail is more than you'd think. It pushes you to be more aggressive to end combat and wassail as quickly as possible.

Add on to the fact it allows build variation by purposely trying to activate wassail for an amazing couple of buffs

Use snapdragon enb with the effectprepass on. It adds character inking. As for the looks of characters, look up npc replacers, many of them are anime esque. Use fairskin for your skin texture and ks hairdos/sg hair pack. Check eskrimmods.blogspot for some armor/clothing mods. BDO pack by team tal is a good armor pack.
Makes you realise how small skyrim really is
